summary: Unusual Machines, Inc. (UMAC) filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement to acquire DroneNX LLC d/b/a Upgrade Energy. The surviving company will issue 1,792,012 shares at ~$13.95/share plus $1M cash at closing, with an earn-out up to $26M cash if the target achieves $10M annual revenue over two years. Implied initial consideration is ~$26M. The merger is subject to customary conditions, including an Upgrade 2025 audit, and is expected to close within 120 days. A registration rights agreement obligates the company to file a resale registration statement post-close. Watch for completion risk and any material adverse change triggers.
